notes: EntityEdge.created_at is a REQUIRED constructor field (no default), so the caller always chooses the record time. Deterministic path = graphiti.nodes.entity.save + graphiti.edges.entity.save: ZERO chat calls (only embeddings, which a command write needs for search anyway). add_triplet is NOT LLM-free: it dedupes/contradiction-checks via the LLM whenever an edge between the nodes already exists (and for node resolution). Decision (ADR-016): P2 writes trusted commands with direct save through a platform projection writer that sets uuid/valid_at/created_at itself; it never calls add_triplet/add_episode. Supersession for commands is done by the writer (set invalid_at/expired_at on the previous edge), not by Graphiti. Quirk: an edge read back carries source_uuid/target_uuid inside .attributes; the projection reader must strip them before comparing attributes.
